## Summary

I implemented the disposable-domain email blocklist in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java` (the controller handling `POST /api/owners` where all owner business rules live).

Two changes, both scoped to the existing email-validation path:

1. Added a `DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS` set constant with `mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, and `guerrillamail.com`.
2. Extended `normalizeEmail(...)` so that after the existing syntactic check and lower-casing, it extracts the domain (part after `@`) and throws `InvalidRequestException(List.of("email"))` — which maps to **400 Bad Request** — when the domain is on the blocklist.

The check runs on the lower-cased address, so it's case-insensitive, and it only applies when an email is provided (blank/absent email still returns `null` as before). The new `Cp38Tests` acceptance test passes and no existing tests regressed.
